newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE gilts hit new contract high above 113-19.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE gilts hit new contract high above 113-19.

text.p: June gilts soared to a new contract high above the old high at 113-19 on Tuesday after British Chancellor Gordon Brown raised interest rates by a quarter point to 6.25 percent and announced substantial moves towards independence for the Bank of England.

By 1115 GMT the June contract on LIFFE was up 2-16/32 points on the day at 113-20, just above the old contract high of 113-19. June short sterling was up 0.05 basis points at 93.40 and the September contract was up 0.06 at 93.19 from 93.10 before the move.
The 10-year gilt/Bund spread was at 151 basis points from 173 before.
